project.name: osgi/foundation/operator-notifier-port
project.description: The operator-notification port: the one door toward the operator's desktop (OperatorNotifier — browse a URL / show a banner), for a scenario that must signal a human gesture mid-run when console (pulumi gRPC) and runbook (end-only) are both unusable. Cross-cutting, belongs to no domain — type=contract, bundle-wired, satisfied by operator-notifier-edge over java.desktop. First consumer: the ghapp registration.
